description: Read metric sensor depth at a point you select inside a visible surface in CURRENT original RGB. Uses no detector or segmentation model. Returns the sampled pixel, depth validity and a marked evidence image. Coordinates use the original scene bounds, not a resized preview or a map image. Sensor depth is not horizontal distance or target-center distance; target identity and completion remain visual judgments.

pixel_x.description: Zero-based column in the original RGB, increasing to the right; must be less than scene width.

pixel_y.description: Zero-based row in the original RGB, increasing downward; must be less than scene height.
